meta.title: Libertarian–traditional values (GAL–TAN)
meta.question: Are Poles becoming more libertarian or more traditional?
meta.measure: Average position on social and cultural questions, from 0 (libertarian) to 10 (traditional)
meta.anchor: The average of six issue trends (abortion, gay and lesbian rights, the Church and the state, immigration and refugees, the environment and climate, nationalism), each pooled from the questions that ask about it, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.
